metadata.title: On deformations of foliated complex analytic structures III: Unfoldings
metadata.abstract: We study unfoldings of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves. We prove theorem of existence for unfoldings of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves for one-parameter families. We prove theorem of completeness for unfoldings of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves. We also present unfoldings of foliated nonsingular varieties defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves in the language of functors of Artin rings which is the algebraic version of unfoldings of foliated complex analytic structures. We identify first-order unfoldings and obstructions.

analysis.workSummary: 对余切层局部自由子层定义的叶状复解析结构建立单参数 unfolding 的存在与完备性定理，并以 Artin 环函子表达代数版本，识别一阶 unfolding 与障碍。
analysis.breakthrough: 把解析 unfolding 与代数变形语言连接，提供结构变形的框架。
